notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Dear friends! The year 2024 is coming to an end. And we are looking forward to the New Year 2025 with hope! Our team has done a lot of work in the past year. Very soon we will finally be able to announce our new game. And, as we hope, begin a new era in the history of N-Game Studios. We are looking forward to this moment! And we wish you all good health, prosperity, and great success in all your endeavors in the New Year - and, of course, cool new games. Including new games from our studio! We wish you to believe in miracles, friends, yourself, and the future! Stay with us. And Happy New Year!

notes.title: Robowars is available to buy on Steam again
notes.content: Today our good old tower defense game Robowars returns to Steam after two years. It wasn't easy, but we did it! Several years ago we lost contact with our publisher. It was quite insulting and frustrating to watch what happens with the game and not be able to somehow influence it! Also, we didn't receive any sales reports and royalties for some years. Subsequently, it became known that the publisher went through bankruptcy proceedings and our game was removed from Steam. Recently, we, the original developers of the game, have returned the rights to our project. To bring the game back to Steam, we have prepared an updated build that fixes several critical bugs and improves game balance and localization. We also recompiled the game for modern operating systems (Win 10/11). We are grateful to the Steam team for helping us get the game back on sale. Also, we have reduced the price of the game by four times. It seems to be fair. We hope the community will like it. Have a nice game!

notes.title: Robowars re-released on Steam!
Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content: We are excited to announce that Robowars now has Steam Trading Cards. The set features 5 trading cards, 3 backgrounds, and 5 emoticons. We hope you enjoy them. Thanks for your support!
